channel.title: Block Club Chicago - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Block Club Chicago (blockclubchicago.org)

item.title: Pullman’s Historic Hotel Florence To Be Restored As Part Of $100 Million State Project
item.description: Neighbors and community stakeholders hope the project will drive tourism and economic growth to the Far South Side neighborhood, called a “treasured piece of Illinois’ story” by Gov. JB Pritzker.

item.title: 25 Things To Do In Chicago This Weekend: Polar Plunge, Black Makers Market And City Beer Fest
item.description: There are also dance performances, two neighborhood restaurant weeks, a Purim Carnival and a new music and arts festival in Avondale.

item.title: Why Is The Cook County State’s Attorney Prosecuting Nonviolent ICE Protesters?
item.description: A Block Club investigation found dozens of protesters arrested by state police are still facing criminal charges for minor infractions, such as sitting on a concrete barrier — even after Gov. JB Pritzker vowed to protect their First Amendment rights.

item.title: Chicago Primary Election 2026: Everything You Need To Know About Voting March 17
item.description: Here's key information on the races and details on how and when you can vote in Chicago.

item.title: Mayor Defends City Animal Shelter Leader Amid Pushback From Alderpeople, Advocates
item.description: Mayor Brandon Johnson praised Susan Cappello’s experience during a press conference at Animal Care and Control and stood firm on his decision to appoint her permanent director of the struggling agency.

item.title: Rev. Jesse Jackson’s Weeklong ‘Celebration Of Life’ Gets Underway At Rainbow PUSH
item.description: Thursday’s public viewing kicks off a week of memorials. "We want to welcome the public to come show their love and respect for a man who showed so much love and respect for all of humanity," a Rainbow PUSH board member said.

item.title: Maggie Winters’ Comedy Special To Debut On St. Patrick’s Day, Which Is Very On Brand
item.description: Beverly plays a big role in "Marguerite," which explores the rising comic's life on the South Side and beyond. She's headlining a show Saturday at Gaelic Park.

item.title: 2 Youth-Focused Community Centers On West Side Get $15 Million Funding Boost
item.description: The One Lawndale Recreation Center in North Lawndale and La Villita Erie House Center in Little Village will offer year-round space and programs for kids and families.

item.title: WWE Returns To United Center After 32-Year Hiatus
item.description: Saturday’s Elimination Chamber event marks World Wrestling Entertainment’s first major show in Chicago since 1994, one the city’s tourism arm hopes is the start of a “long-term relationship.”

item.title: DePaul Art Museum Closing In June: ‘It’s A Huge Loss’
item.description: The museum's final exhibits will open March 5. The decision to close was made "to ensure long-term financial sustainability for our university," DePaul's president announced Thursday.
